name: What is the difference between installing an alcove tub and a freestanding tub?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between installing an alcove tub and a freestanding tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding tubs act as a focal design element and offer flexible placement, but they require generous floor space, specific floor-mounted or wall-mounted filler valves, and extra cleaning access around the perimeter. Alcove tubs fit into a three-walled enclosure, making them ideal for combination shower-tub setups and smaller footprints. While alcove tubs maximize functional room in standard layouts, freestanding models may require reinforcement of the subfloor due to concentrated weight when filled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alcove tubs fit between three walls to save space and integrate with showers, while freestanding tubs need more open floor area, dedicated plumbing lines, and easy cleaning clearance.
